description_en: Queries abnormal cloud native mode resources
description_zh: 查询异常的云产品接入资源
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-abnormal-cloud-resources --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAbnormalCloudResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to obtain the WAF instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

items.description_zh: 异常状态的云产品接入信息

CloudResourceId.description_zh: 接入的资源ID，由WAF自动生成

Details.description_en: The detailed information about the exception

items.description_en: The detailed information about the exception

AppliedType.description_en:
The type of the certificate used for the HTTPS protocol. Valid values:

default: The default certificate.

extension: The extension certificate
AppliedType.description_zh:
HTTPS协议的证书类型。取值：

default：表示默认证书。

extension：表示拓展证书

CertName.description_en: The name of the certificate in Certificate Management Service
CertName.description_zh: 数字证书管理服务的证书名称

Code.description_en:
The cause of the exception. Valid values:

InvalidCert: The certificate is invalid.

ClientCertOpend: Mutual authentication is enabled.

NetworkConfigLost: A network exception occurred.

UserUploadCert: A user-uploaded certificate exists.

CertNotExistInCertCenter: The certificate ID does not exist in Certificate Management Service.

CertExpired: The certificate has expired.

EmptyCertCN: The Common Name (CN) is empty
Code.description_zh:
异常原因，取值：

InvalidCert：表示无效证书。

ClientCertOpend：表示开启了双向认证。

NetworkConfigLost：表示网络异常。

UserUploadCert：表示存在用户上传的证书。

CertNotExistInCertCenter：表示证书ID在数字证书管理服务不存在。

CertExpired：表示证书过期。

EmptyCertCN：表示CommonName空

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 证书的到期时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

ProductCertId.description_en: The ID of the certificate configured in the cloud service console
ProductCertId.description_zh: 在云产品控制台配置的证书ID

ProductCertName.description_en: The name of the certificate configured in the cloud service console
ProductCertName.description_zh: 在云产品控制台配置证书的证书名称

ProductDomainExtension.description_en: The domain extension configured in the cloud service console
ProductDomainExtension.description_zh: 云产品控制台配置的扩展域名

ResourceInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID added to WAF

ResourceInstanceName.description_en: The name of the instance added to WAF

ResourceInstancePort.description_en: The port of the instance added to WAF

ResourceProduct.description_en:
The cloud service to which the resource belongs. By default, instances of ALB, MSE, FC, and SAE are returned. Valid values:

alb: ALB.

mse: MSE.

fc: FC.

sae: SAE.

ecs: ECS.
clb4: CLB (TCP).
clb7: CLB (HTTP/HTTPS).
nlb: NLB.

Different cloud services are supported in different regions. If you specify a value for the product filter field, check the cloud services supported in the region. Otherwise, the filtering may fail
ResourceProduct.description_zh:
资源所属云产品，默认返回ALB、MSE、FC和SAE产品的实例，取值：

alb：表示ALB产品。

mse：表示MSE产品。

fc：表示FC产品。

sae：表示SAE产品。

ecs：表示ECS产品。
clb4：表示CLB(TCP)产品。
clb7：表示CLB(HTTP/HTTPS)产品。
nlb：表示NLB产品。

每个产品支持的地域不同，产品筛选字段有值时，需要参考地域支持的产品，否则可能导致筛选失败
